name: move-player-to-slot
description: Move a player into a starting slot on the Team tab (for example start a bench QB, which benches the current starter). Opens the row's Move Player sheet via the unlabeled button left of the name, then taps the target slot. The final tap is a roster change. Params: league, player (name as shown, e.g. P. Mahomes), slot_desc (content description of the target row, e.g. QB slot).
